title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who greets the guests at Vitu-Ghazi and consents on Orzhov's behalf as Proft stages his reveal.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective who gathers the guild leaders and exposes the killer.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin cleared of guilt who aids Proft and speaks for House Dimir.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator who guards Krenko and helps arrange the gathering.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency who lets Proft present his findings.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros warleader who brings Massacre Girl in chains.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The Azorius leader who agrees not to prosecute Etrata or Proft.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The Simic leader who criticizes the Agency and the Boros.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet guild leader who mourns the death of one of his inventors.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos representative who has been trying to blame her own parun.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Gruul centaur who speaks for the clans and thanks the Agency for not killing Anzrag.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin hustler with a pardon, anxious about his safety.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos assassin whom Aurelia keeps chained.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A Golgari leader who appears out of the shadows to approve the proceedings.

entities.name: Tolsimir
entities.description: A Selesnya elf who confesses falsely to protect the true killer.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The three-faced dryad of Vitu-Ghazi whom Proft names as the mastermind of the killings.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: The dryad of order, one of Trostani's three faces, furious.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The dryad of harmony, one of Trostani's faces, horrified.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The dryad of life, one of Trostani's faces, serene.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: The Gruul god recaptured in an evidence capsule.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: An Izzet inventor killed in the plot.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The murdered Orzhov leader.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The murdered Simic figure.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The Rakdos demon-leader that Judith has tried to frame.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who embodies the Guildpact.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: The Azorius founder who worded the Guildpact.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A friend on Kaldheim who has offered Kaya a fishing trip.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya guildhall that hosts the gathering and whose roots spread across the city.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane Kaya longs to visit.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The founding pact that exempts Etrata from consequence and lets Kaya consent for Orzhov.

entities.name: Mind-control flower
entities.description: A bruise-purple flower of unnatural origin that emits yellow-gray pollen and subverts a person's will once.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of Trostani and Tolsimir, which Proft identifies as the source of the flower.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The independent investigators led by Ezrim.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Aurelia's enforcement guild.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild led by Lavinia.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Vannifar's guild.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ral's guild.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild Judith represents.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild represented by Yarus.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Teysa's guild, now without a named successor.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The undercity guild that sends Izoni.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The spy guild Etrata speaks for.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders Proft rules out as the source of the flower.

events.summary: Kaya greets Judith, who arrives at Vitu-Ghazi in a Rakdos coach.
events.quote: The door swung open, and Judith stepped out

events.summary: Judith says Rakdos is preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica.
events.quote: His Viciousness is somewhat too preoccupied preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica

events.summary: Ezrim lands carrying Yarus, who was summoned as the Gruul speaker.
events.quote: Ezrim came gliding in for a landing

events.summary: Ezrim and Yarus confirm that Yarus did not free Anzrag, and Yarus thanks the Agency for sparing the god.
events.quote: Yarus didn't release Anzrag from the evidence capsule

events.summary: Ral, Vannifar and Krenko arrive; Kaya shows Krenko to Trostani's sanctum.
events.quote: Vannifar was the last of the guild leaders to arrive, shortly after Ral

events.summary: Aurelia confronts Kaya at the gathering with Massacre Girl chained beside her.
events.quote: Aurelia was the first to move, rising with a flurry of feathers from the leather armchair she'd been occupying

events.summary: Proft steps out of a shadow clapping, and Etrata reveals herself.
events.quote: Detective Proft stepping out of a shadow that couldn't possibly have concealed him for this long

events.summary: Proft argues the Guildpact exempts Etrata from consequences for her escape.
events.quote: I believe you'll find the Guildpact exempts her from any consequence for that action.

events.summary: Proft declares that the killer is in the room.
events.quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

events.summary: The guild leaders consent to the interviews, with Kaya consenting for the Orzhov and Izoni for the Golgari.
events.quote: The Golgari approve.

events.summary: Proft takes Kaya aside and a strange white root grows from the wallpaper into a bruise-colored flower.
events.quote: The movement proved to be a white, wormlike root, uncurling from the pattern in the wallpaper, spiraling into a thicker base.

events.summary: Proft traps the flower in an evidence jar as it emits yellow-gray pollen.
events.quote: Proft clamped a clear glass evidence jar over the flower just as it began to emit a puff of yellow-gray dust.

events.summary: Proft sets the jar before the assembled leaders to begin his presentation.
events.quote: He held up his jar, turning so that everyone would have a chance to see

events.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
events.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

events.summary: Proft explains that loss of memory is the connecting thread.
events.quote: The loss of memory is the connecting thread.

events.summary: Proft calls out Judith for trying to throw blame on Rakdos.
events.quote: You've been trying, desperately, to throw blame on your own parun at every step along the way.

events.summary: Proft recounts Izoni's analysis of the powder.
events.quote: Izoni of the Golgari examined it on my behalf

events.summary: Proft says the flower is not Phyrexian and that his announced interviews were a ruse to bait the killer.
events.quote: This flower is not Phyrexian in origin.

events.summary: Proft reveals the killer must be a member of the Selesnya Conclave.
events.quote: This is a creation of the Conclave. Our killer is a member of the Selesnya.

events.summary: Proft explains that Vitu-Ghazi's roots could deliver the flowers anywhere in the city.
events.quote: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city.

events.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
events.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

events.summary: Lavinia agrees Proft and Etrata committed no crime.
events.quote: It'll take months to clear the paperwork, and I'm not happy about it, but yes, we're agreed

events.summary: Tolsimir falsely confesses to the killings.
events.quote: I sent my most faithful to confront the Agency lackeys after they came here to consult the Guildpact.

events.summary: Proft dismisses Tolsimir's confession, noting he lacked the ability to create the plant.
events.quote: Noble of you to try to take the burden of blame onto yourself, but you didn't do this

events.summary: Proft names Trostani as the mastermind behind all the killings.
events.quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

relations.note: masterminded the mind-controlled killings of guild leaders
